meta.note: Pattern Genome lite — reusable MECHANISMS, not examples (store the why, not the artifact). Consumed by script-writing: pick one hook archetype + one container per reel, camera phrases go verbatim into scene.camera. Confidence per July-2026 research sweep (docs/virality-rubric.md sources); re-validate quarterly — patterns age.

hooks.mechanism: Contrarian/absolute statement inside 2s creates instant stake; viewer stays to judge it.
hooks.when: Category myths, positioning against habit (e.g. 'not a cream').
hooks.source: OpusClip hook taxonomy; TikTok for Business first-seconds data

hooks.mechanism: Open question that cannot be answered yes/no; Zeigarnik loop holds until payoff.
hooks.when: Educational reels; close the loop only in the last second.

hooks.mechanism: Unexpected visual/sound in frame 1 breaks scroll autopilot; no logo intros ever.
hooks.when: Saturated feeds; macro texture or needle-to-bottle contrast for skincare.

hooks.mechanism: Lead with the RESULT (number, before/after) — trust borrowed from evidence, story explains after.
hooks.source: OpusClip proof-first archetype; med-spa case studies

containers.mechanism: Transformation wrapped in a client story/voiceover — narrative carries the proof past ad-blindness.
containers.when: Strongest med-aesthetic format; needs real (consented) imagery.

containers.mechanism: Sets up a wrong guess, corrects it — double retention beat (guess + reveal).
containers.when: Lighthearted clinic content; 7Q Spa case hit 2.4M views organically.

containers.mechanism: 'The thing your clinic uses, decoded' — authority + insider access. Exosomes/PDRN trend arc (celebrity catalysts) makes this hot now.
containers.when: Unaware/problem-aware patients; our default educational container.
containers.source: Business of Fashion PDRN/exosome trend reporting

containers.mechanism: Comparison is self-sustaining: viewers argue in comments, algorithm reads debate as engagement.
containers.when: Product-aware; Medicube-vs-Anua style formats in K-beauty prove it.
containers.source: BoF / Get the Gloss K-beauty comparison meta

camera.phrase: focus change from foreground to subject

camera.when: diagrams, texture — max one per reel

camera.phrase: slow push-in through the gel layer (Through Object)

grammar_rules: One named camera move per clip — two moves confuse the model.
Camera instruction goes LAST in the video prompt.
Always add a 'slow' modifier — fast moves warp; orbits <=30 degrees.
Subject → environment → action → lighting → style → camera (Kling order).

negative.mechanism: Branding in frame 1 signals 'ad' — instant scroll.
Any shot >4s without visual change is the top drop-off trigger.
>5 hashtags is hard-capped by IG (Dec 2025) and reads as spam.
Verbal CTA inside the video body kills retention; CTA belongs in caption/comments.
Business accounts can't legally use trending commercial audio — mute-risk + takedowns; bake licensed tracks at render.
